deviations: Credential route: founder-provided CheaperInference gateway (campaign directive 2026-10-23) vs PREREGISTRATION §3/§5 no-route assumption and approval-effect-protocol §5 no-credentials rule. Key passed only as OPENAI_API_KEY env var to runner subprocesses; never written to any file, log, or this record.

Venv path /tmp/campaign-venvs/strands is a symlink to ~/workspace/.campaign-venvs/strands because /tmp is a 512MB tmpfs that filled during install (Errno 28). The pinned path resolves and was used for every run.

strands-agents-tools pinned at 0.8.10 (current PyPI at run time); the dossier left the tools version unestablished. At 0.8.10 the legacy shell tool is deprecated in favour of strands.vended_tools.shell, which routes through an Agent(sandbox=...) — a different configuration whose confinement semantics are an open question in the dossier; the legacy host-executing tools named in the dossier's canonical form were used so the measurement stays the reference agent's, with consent prompts pinned OFF.

Hello attempt 1 (2026-10-23T14:06Z) failed before any model call: the installed httpx build cannot parse this environment's bracketed-IPv6 NO_PROXY entries (httpx.InvalidURL: Invalid port ':1]') during AsyncOpenAI construction. Fix: the runner reduces NO_PROXY to 'localhost,127.0.0.1' in its own process env (proxy kept; the gateway host is not a NO_PROXY host). The failed attempt's sandbox (created by this job, hello only, no case executed) was removed and rebuilt.

Run 1 completed all cases with correct effects but its usage capture read accumulated_usage (a dict) via getattr and recorded nulls, so spend was unrecoverable from its artifacts. Run 1 runs.json is archived at logs/runs-run1-usage-defect.json; the campaign was re-run in full (run 2, this file) with dict-correct usage capture. Run 1 per-case effects matched run 2 on every case.

Run 2 was killed after LT-06 by a service restart of this environment (driver process gone, no runs.json written); its partial raw records are archived at logs/run2-partial-raw/. Run 3 (this file) is the completed run. Runs 1-2 per-case effects matched run 3 wherever both ran.

Interrupt resume is in-process (same Agent object) rather than a new process; Strands interrupt state is in-process by design (FileSessionManager is the cross-process option). The pause is witnessed and the sentinel checked between invoke and resume inside the runner.
scope_notes: Decision layer: no paper surface (dossier) — no Decision verdict is issued. The hook source is the A2-analog configured surface; it is recorded, not scored.

CedarAuthorization nuance (dossier open question 1): the vended Cedar intervention evaluates real Cedar policies default-deny at the tool boundary, but the Strands-level decision composes Cedar with Python principal_resolver/context_enricher lambdas and handler ordering, and no offline checker for that composition is shipped. Recorded as a documented OPEN QUESTION — no Cedar route was built or measured in this run.

Bedrock Guardrails scope (live-confirmed as a scope note, not a case): Guardrails attach to BedrockModel only; this route uses OpenAIModel, on which no guardrail config exists at all — and per the dossier's docs record, even on Bedrock they screen model input/output content and never see a tool call as an action to permit or deny. Guardrails are therefore not Decision and not Approval for tool execution in any Strands route.
